integrity: Symbolic argument with explicit Perron-spectrum and border-derivative steps. Numerical checks are independent finite illustrations, not proofs of the infinite case. No independent validation has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Only limiting one-density for balanced forbidden binary words of even length at least four with at most two imbalanced proper borders. The stopped-process density q and cancellation among three or more borders are not settled.
title: Two-imbalance border rigidity for balanced forbidden binary words
